verdict.rationale: Data can be pulled out programmatically: the App API fetches data (customer-io-docs-23), data-out integrations send data to CRMs, analytics and other platforms (customer-io-docs-29), and the CLI gives agents full workspace access with structured JSON output over a published OpenAPI spec (customer-io-docs-26, customer-io-docs-48, customer-io-docs-49, customer-io-probe-2). However, nothing documents a dedicated complete-account export or migration-out path, so leaving with all your data means assembling it yourself through APIs and integrations. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/full-workspace export, explicit open-format exports (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps of profiles, events, messages and automations), and hands-on corroboration of a successful data exit.
